# libsvm

- Source: https://github.com/cjlin1/libsvm, tag `v336` (LIBSVM 3.36), files
  `svm.cpp`, `svm.h`, `COPYRIGHT`, `README`, fetched 2026-11-09, unchanged.
- Licence: BSD 3-clause (see `COPYRIGHT`). Chih-Chung Chang and Chih-Jen Lin.
- Used for: the C-SVC models (linear, polynomial, RBF kernels) of the
  classification port, as scikit-learn's SVC wraps the same library.
- Citation: Chang, C.-C. and Lin, C.-J. (2011). LIBSVM: a library for support
  vector machines. ACM Transactions on Intelligent Systems and Technology
  2(3):27:1-27:27.
